market_definition: The electrically conductive adhesives market comprises polymer adhesives filled with silver, copper, carbon or other conductive particles to create electrical connections. It measures sales of isotropic and anisotropic adhesives, pastes and films for electronic interconnect. BY CONDUCTIVITY TYPE: Isotropic Conductive Adhesives (ICA), Anisotropic Conductive Adhesives (ACA). BY FILLER TYPE: Silver, Copper, Carbon / Graphene, Other Fillers. BY FORM: Paste, Film, Ink-Like Dispensable. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics & EV Batteries, Industrial & Power Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Medical Devices, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Thermally conductive adhesives; solder pastes and conductive inks; ordinary electronic adhesives with no conductive function. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
